title: Telex Application Client (supported long-lived application integration)
summary: The supported Application Client core and Rust-first binding are complete. Issue #149 and PR #151 landed telex::application_client at reviewed head c03db454781164f47a20e997665fe1251e07bd15, merged as ddedfab57cc305a1e91a81d7e49e712bb36d32fd. Client-conformance is eligible for separate shaping but remains planned without a tracker or reviewed task spec; consumers and later gates remain blocked on declared dependencies.

nodes.title: Supported Application Client core
nodes.summary: Completed through issues #129 and #124 and PR #132 at head 6fd3c1133948f0cefe83948947f2d85d2db0a298, merged as 4ecbe84e99e00ab0cea3bcf3619d539c222746af: one supported typed core implements AC-C01 through AC-C20 across SQLite and Postgres, including the extensible membership-loss model and regenerated bundle.

nodes.title: First supported Rust binding
nodes.summary: Completed through issue #149 and PR #151 at exact reviewed head c03db454781164f47a20e997665fe1251e07bd15, merged as ddedfab57cc305a1e91a81d7e49e712bb36d32fd. The root telex crate now exposes telex::application_client with supported defaults-disabled backend profiles, caller-owned Tokio, cancellation-safe lifecycle evidence, source compatibility guidance, and no external binding or private fallback.

nodes.title: Application Client conformance and migration
nodes.summary: Next node eligible for separate task shaping and reviewed launch preparation. Prove the supported core and Rust binding against SQLite/Postgres, restart and membership loss, multi-address compensation, send-only/bidirectional capability, delivery-row identity, receipt-state separation, retry-safe operations, ordered resync, and migration away from temporary seams. Keep planned until a tracker and reviewed task spec exist.

nodes.title: Supported client is consumable by both product workstreams
nodes.summary: Operator Station and Watcher validate the supported client against their merged contracts and confirm no product-private integration seam is required before product integration continues.

nodes.title: Application Client operational hardening
nodes.summary: Harden packaging, install/upgrade, diagnostics, cleanup, resource bounds, credentialed Postgres, delayed or duplicated delivery, process replacement, and additional binding ergonomics after both consumers can integrate. Sketch; detail after the consumer gate.

nodes.title: Application Client workstream reconciled
nodes.summary: Builder accepts the supported client, conformance evidence, consumer integration, migration guidance, and operational hardening, then reconciles durable lessons into both product workstreams and campaign closure.
